name: wplabru Receipt Delivery for Self-Employed
author: wplabru

sections.description:
This is an independent plugin by wplabru. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or an official product of the Federal Tax Service of Russia or the My Tax (Moy Nalog) application.

This free plugin helps Russian self-employed sellers who use the professional income tax regime (NPD) keep and deliver existing tax receipts for WooCommerce orders.

Create the official receipt yourself in the Russian Federal Tax Service’s My Tax application (Moy Nalog). Then add its official link, upload a receipt file, or use both. Review the payment details and send the receipt to the customer’s billing email address.

The plugin does not create, cancel or verify tax receipts. It does not sign into your tax account or register income. Sellers remain responsible for the accuracy and legal timing of their receipts.

Features:

  • An orders table under WooCommerce > Receipts, with search, dates, order status and receipt status filters.
  • Official receipt links and private PDF, JPG or PNG attachments up to 5 MB.
  • Editable seller details, sender name, sender email and reply-to email.
  • Editable email subject and content with order and receipt placeholders.
  • A neutral light email layout, or your own HTML layout using the [content] placeholder.
  • A sandboxed preview and test emails containing demonstration data.
  • Receipt revisions, action history and an explicit confirmation for resending.
  • A manual status for receipts delivered in person or through another channel.
  • A receipt panel in WooCommerce orders and access for logged-in order owners.
  • A reminder to review the receipt after an order refund.
  • Support for WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and legacy order storage.
  • A fully translatable administration interface, email messages and in-plugin guide.

All features are free. No activation key, subscription or account with the plugin author is required. WooCommerce 8.2 or later is required.

Privacy and external services

The plugin does not use an external receipt-generation service, analytics, license server or an FTS API. No password or token for My Tax is requested. No receipt data is sent to the plugin author.

Seller settings, receipt metadata, private file bytes, customer email addresses and action history are stored on the WordPress site. They should be covered by the store’s backup and privacy policies. Email content and attachments pass through the mail service configured by the site administrator.

Administrators may add official receipt links on https://lknpd.nalog.ru/. Customers who open these links visit the Federal Tax Service website. The plugin does not automatically fetch or validate the remote receipt. Information about My Tax is available at https://npd.nalog.ru/.

The bundled standard email contains no remote images or fonts. If you add an externally hosted image to your own HTML template, the recipient’s mail client may request that image from the server you chose.

Temporary files used for email attachments are created locally with private permissions and removed after the send attempt. Private receipt files are not placed in the public media library.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce 8.2 or later.
  2. Install this plugin through Plugins > Add New, or upload its ZIP archive.
  3. Open WooCommerce > Receipts > Email and settings (labels follow the installed language pack).
  4. Enter the seller’s full name, 12-digit tax identification number, sender information and contact details. Save the settings.
  5. Send a test email to your own address and check the preview. The test uses demonstration data and does not create a tax receipt.
  6. Open an order. Add the receipt link or file that you created in My Tax. Verify the amount, line items and actual settlement date and time.
  7. Save and review the receipt, then send it to the customer. Saving alone does not send an email.

When switching from version 0.3.5 or earlier to this newly named package, deactivate the previous package first. The new folder is wplabru-receipt-delivery; stored receipts and settings are reused.

If replacing the earlier private WP LAB build with the separate directory build, deactivate the private build first. Both builds use the same existing receipt tables and settings. Keep only one build active.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin create or cancel official receipts?

No. Create and manage official receipts in My Tax. The plugin stores existing receipts and helps you deliver them to your customers.

Does an order payment automatically send a receipt?

No. Sending is a manual action. You can also mark a receipt as delivered through another channel.

What does the Sent status mean?

It means the site’s mail system accepted the send request. It does not confirm delivery to an inbox or that the customer has read the email. The plugin uses the site’s existing WordPress mail configuration or SMTP plugin.

Which files can I attach?

PDF, JPG and PNG files up to 5 MB, subject to the server’s upload limit. Their extensions and actual contents are checked. Files are stored in a private database table, not in the public media library.

Can I customize the email design?

Yes. Use the neutral standard layout, or select Custom HTML and provide your own layout. Include [content] exactly once for the email content. Templates may use presentation tables and safe inline styles. Scripts, forms and unsafe markup are removed. No branded email design is bundled.

Will my existing settings and receipts survive an update?

Yes. Existing seller details, sender settings, subject, message content, custom HTML, receipt files and action history are retained. The directory build and the earlier private build share the same storage identifiers.

What happens after a refund?

The plugin adds a reminder to review the receipt. It does not change the receipt amount or cancel a receipt in the tax service. Review the official receipt yourself, then update the order’s receipt if necessary.

What happens when I deactivate or delete the plugin?

Settings, receipts and history are retained to prevent accidental loss of financial documents. Reinstalling the plugin reuses this data. Database backups should include these private tables.

Who can download receipt files?

Authorized administrators and shop managers can manage receipts for orders they are permitted to edit. Logged-in customers can download the current receipt for their own orders. Guest customers receive files as email attachments. Old receipt versions are restricted to authorized staff.

Can I use several receipts for one order?

The plugin keeps revisions but supports only one current receipt per order. Concurrent active receipts for separate payments are not supported.
sections.changelog:
0.3.6

  • Added the distinctive wplabru name and aligned package identifiers with the requested directory slug.
  • Made interface, email and JavaScript messages translatable through WordPress language packs.
  • Removed bundled translation files from the submission archive.
  • Scoped compatibility notices to the Plugins and receipt screens.
  • Corrected the contributor account and clarified the independent relationship to My Tax and the FTS.

0.3.5

  • Removed WooCommerce from the plugin name and package identifiers for directory submission.
  • Kept existing settings, receipt files and history in the same storage.

0.3.4

  • Clarified the plugin name and short descriptions for self-employed NPD sellers.

0.3.3

  • Added the Russian plugin name and description through standard WordPress metadata translations.
  • Included Russian PO/MO files that work before and after activation.
  • Prepared Russian installation instructions, FAQ and a separate readme translation for the directory.
  • Retained the existing folder, receipt data and settings.

0.3.2

  • Addressed Plugin Check findings in request validation, escaping and private temporary-file handling.
  • Added explicit nonce verification when saving a receipt and safer validation of upload and settings data.
  • Replaced interpolated SQL column lists with fixed queries and identifier placeholders.
  • Cached immutable receipt metadata without caching private file contents.
  • Documented the required uncached audit and atomic locking queries.
  • Added this English readme and a separate directory build with a neutral name and folder.
  • Retained existing settings, receipts, revisions and storage identifiers.

0.3.1

  • Removed the bundled branded email layout and its reset button.
  • Kept the neutral standard email and custom HTML support.
  • Removed the forced dark background for custom HTML.

0.3.0

  • Added the WP LAB administration design, grouped sender settings and an in-plugin guide.
  • Added a neutral default email and documentation for free distribution.

0.2.1

  • Added a configurable sender name for receipt and test emails.

0.2.0

  • Added a configurable sender email, editable HTML layout and email preview.

0.1.0

  • Initial release: existing receipt links and files, manual delivery, order integration and action history.
